in_marathi.name: Vivansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God in the form of knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vivansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vivansh means 'God in the form of knowledge'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Viv' meaning 'knowledge' and 'Ansh' meaning 'God or form'. It reflects the power of knowledge and wisdom, and the belief that knowledge is a manifestation of the divine.
